_doc: The Lab's catalogue (docs/design/lab-parts-and-pay.md): what each part and plate is called, costs, and says, and when the Company starts selling it (unlock = sectors certified). What a part does in the water is game/sim/kit.gd. The pay is here too.

lamp.name: STANDARD LAMP
lamp.text: Six tiles ahead, a 70 degree cone.

tool.name: LASER
tool.text: The Company's patent. SHOOT, once the plate is issued.

parts.name: SPOTLIGHT
parts.text: Ten tiles, a narrow cone. Sees far; is seen far.
parts.story: A narrow beam for long corridors: it reaches ten tiles, but the cone is less than half as wide. Jellyfish see it from as far away as he sees them.

parts.name: FLOODLIGHT
parts.text: Three and a half tiles, almost all the way round.
parts.story: Light everywhere close by and nowhere far: it sees round corners and what waits at his side, and never down a corridor.

parts.name: RED LAMP
parts.text: Jellyfish can't see red. The lamp stays on; they don't come.
parts.story: Most things in the deep can't see red light at all. The jellyfish don't come to it. The Company's engineers say this is a coincidence.

parts.name: TWIN SCREWS
parts.text: Half again as fast. Loud: eels hear him twice as far.
parts.story: Two four-bladed screws: half as fast again, and thirstier. The eels hear him six tiles off instead of three.

parts.name: SILENT FINS
parts.text: Slower. Eels can't hear him at all.
parts.story: Soft fins instead of screws. He swims at seven tenths, and makes no sound the eels can hear.

parts.name: FLARE LAUNCHER
parts.text: New card: DROP FLARE. Jellyfish go to the flare, not his lamp.
parts.story: Three flares in a rack. Each burns for ten seconds where he drops it, and jellyfish nearby gather on it instead of him. Replaces the laser while fitted.

parts.name: HYDROPHONE
parts.text: New card: IF HEARD. Eels and shellbacks, eight tiles, through rock.
parts.story: An ear trumpet on the hatch. It hears eels and shellbacks eight tiles away, rock or no rock. It doesn't hear jellyfish: they make no sound.

parts.name: BATTERY BANK
parts.story: Two spare cells slung under his belly. Forty per cent more charge for long sectors.

parts.name: RESERVE CELL
parts.text: When the charge runs out, he gets 15% back. Once.
parts.story: A sealed cell that wakes when the main one dies: a second wind of fifteen per cent, once per dive.

parts.name: PLATING
parts.text: Two more knocks. A tenth slower.
parts.story: A riveted belt of armour round his middle: five knocks instead of three, and a tenth slower for the weight.

parts.name: INSULATED HULL
parts.text: A shut valve doesn't sting. Its crush still kills.
parts.story: Rubberised seams. The valves' stings don't get through; nothing stops a valve closing on him.

plates.name: TURN LEFT / RIGHT
plates.text: A quarter turn from where he faces.

plates.name: IF BEACON IN SIGHT
plates.text: Water all the way to the beacon.

plates.name: IF STUCK
plates.text: He's got nowhere in two seconds.

plates.name: IF HIT
plates.text: He was hurt in the last two seconds.
